about_blocks.text: The Matsqui Abbotsford IMPACT Society is a non-profit organization with major funding from the Fraser Health Authority and significant funding from the Province of British Columbia. Special activities and projects are also generously funded by numerous Abbotsford, Mission and Fraser Valley area service organizations, as well as through donations from corporate foundations and concerned individuals and businesses. Our clinical staff members all hold certifications as addictions counsellors from accredited educational institutions, and they receive regular clinical supervision, as well as on-going professional development and training throughout the year. The Society’s board of directors consists for professionals with diverse backgrounds and both personal and professional ties to the vision and mission of the IMPACT Society.

sponsor.title: Start Your Journey Now
sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
